name: Rotating Text
description: Cycles through a list of phrases, animating each one in and out per character, word, or line with selectable motion effects, optional stagger, blur, and a highlighted pill that resizes to fit.
contents: Inline rotating text span with per-character, word, line, or custom-separator animation
Optional colored highlight pill with auto contrast text color and spring width
Screen reader only copy of the current text
behavior: Advances to the next text every rotationInterval ms and loops by default
Characters animate in and out with the chosen effect, direction, and stagger order
Highlight mode animates the pill width to fit each new text
Exposes next, previous, jumpTo, and reset through a ref
Respects the user reduced motion setting
editableByProps: List of texts, rotation timing, looping, auto play, and pause on hover
Effect, direction, stagger amount and origin, blur, and split unit
Custom initial, animate, exit, and transition motion states
Highlight pill on or off and its color
Classes for the root, word, and character levels, plus inline style
Manual control through ref methods and onNext callback

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or change a built-in effect
Change the highlight pill padding or corner radius
needsCodeEdit.where: className branch for highlight in the root motion.span

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the light or dark text contrast threshold on highlight
Tune pill width or layout spring feel

fixed: Requires the motion package (motion/react) and Tailwind CSS classes
texts is required and must be an array of strings
Inline element with no frame, size and font come from the parent or mainClassName
Animated characters are aria-hidden, a sr-only span carries the current text
Segmentation uses Intl.Segmenter for English graphemes when available
Random stagger order is reshuffled whenever the text changes
Wrapped in MotionConfig reducedMotion user, so transform animations are skipped for reduced motion users
Highlight mode disables layout animation and forces no wrapping

options.look: Text slides vertically in and out with a spring
options.useWhen: Hero headline where a word swaps in a line such as 'Built for teams'

options.look: Characters flip around the X axis like a departure board
options.useWhen: Stats or status line that should feel mechanical and precise

options.look: Soft vertical drift with a blur fade, blur defaults to 10px
options.useWhen: Calm, premium tagline in an editorial or luxury hero

options.look: Characters pop in from small and out to large with a bouncy spring
options.useWhen: Playful headline or kids and entertainment landing page

options.look: Characters fall in from above and drop out below
options.useWhen: Bold, energetic headline for events or product launches
